sections.title: Claims
sections.description: Track credit insurance claims across the account

tooltips.invoice: Optional. Link one or more Due or Overdue invoices. Each selected invoice creates its own claim.
tooltips.status: Current stage of the claim with the insurer.
tooltips.recognized_loss: Amount claimed from the insurer. When invoices are linked, it defaults from each invoice’s open amount × insured %.
tooltips.submission_date: Date the claim was submitted to the insurer. Required once the status is Submitted or later.
tooltips.loss_date: Date used to assign the claim to a Primary policy year (for excess). Defaults from the invoice date when linked; required when status is Rejected or when no invoice is linked.
tooltips.insurer_submission_reference: Reference number from the insurer. Required once the status is Submitted or later.
tooltips.notes: Internal notes for this claim. Not sent to the insurer.

messages.no_claims_description: Issue a claim from an invoice or create one manually for historical backfill.
messages.submitted_requires_fields: Submission date and insurer claim reference are required for this status
messages.submission_date_required: Submission date is required for this status
messages.insurer_reference_required: Insurer claim reference is required for this status
messages.recognized_loss_required: Claim amount is required when no invoice is linked
messages.loss_date_required: Loss date is required when status is Rejected
messages.invoice_id_invalid: Invoice ID must be a positive number
